claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked (types in Type): for arbitrary A, B, E the old-image law r(u a) = inl a implies u injective, hence |A| <= |B| when finite; for arbitrary A, B and E = Unit every injective lift has a law-satisfying recovery r : B -> A + Unit (injective_iff_exists_law; with E empty the converse fails when A is empty and B is not); for injective u the law can be extended by any single value x : A + E at all off-image points (law_freedom_off_image; the independent free value at each off-image point is the content of law_card), so for an off-image point and an old term a0 there are two law-satisfying recoveries, one refusing and one accepting it (off_image_not_implied_general); for any lift u and recovery r, with A nonempty and two distinct observation values, there are observations q, q2 with q2 after u different from q (observation_not_implied_general; the law hypothesis is not used), while q := q2 after u preserves observations on the same lift (observation_preserved_possible), so observation preservation is an extra condition the law neither implies nor excludes; the identity lift satisfies the law while leaving every predicate on the old terms unchanged (repair_not_implied_general, a persistence statement for the identity lift only); for finite A, B and injective u the number of law-satisfying recoveries into A + Unit is (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) (law_card). The three source negative boundaries are fixed Fin instances and are reproduced as such. Native: exhaustive enumeration of all (u, r) pairs for eleven (|A|,|B|,|O|) cases with |A|,|B| <= 4: the number of law pairs, none with a non-injective lift, the number that refuse every off-image point (one per injective lift) and those that do not, observation pairs preserved, and obstruction pairs that persist or clear, all exact integers. Column definitions: persists = number of (law pair, oA, oB) with some a such that oA a and oB (u a); cleared = number with oA nonempty and no such a; these are counting conventions, not a repair notion. obs_preserved, persists and cleared are the law-pair count times a factor independent of r, so they carry no information about the law; the Lean statements carry that claim. The agreement of the producer enumeration with the checker closed forms is the independent evidence, not either alone.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Off-image rejection as a property of the S(n) retraction (that is PG-SN-OFF-IMAGE-REFUSAL, which needs an added soundness hypothesis on r); the pinned SnCarrier lift and retraction; any definition of obstruction repair beyond persistence of a Boolean predicate through a lift (the source repair_not_implied instance uses the constant-true predicate and defines no repair); sets with more than four elements in the native census (the Lean count law_card is general for finite types); infinite types for the count; any physical or categorical reading.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: A recovery r : B -> A + Unit obeying r(u a) = inl a exists exactly when u is injective. For an injective lift it is determined only on the image: there are (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) of them, exactly one of which refuses every off-image point; when |A| >= 1 and |B| > |A| the others accept some off-image point as an old term, and for |B| = |A| or |A| = 0 the recovery is unique. The law fixes neither observations nor obstruction predicates (persistence through the identity lift only).
claim_boundary.next_test: Define repair of an obstruction for a lift (a witness-count or chain criterion on the lifted pair) and decide for the identity embedding and for a non-identity injective lift whether the old obstruction count strictly drops, replacing the constant-predicate instance of repair_not_implied by a statement with a stated repair criterion.

# PG-OLD-IMAGE-INJECTIVE

No operation candidate was recovered, so the declarations were mined by hand: Paper.lean line 54 (old_image_injective, a general theorem over arbitrary types A B E) and Paper001.lean lines 103 (E = Unit), 111, 128, 138. The injectivity theorem is general and non-vacuous. The three negative-boundary theorems are fixed Fin instances (off_image_not_implied: u constant 0 and r constant inl 0 on Fin 1 -> Fin 2; observation_not_implied: identity on Fin 2; repair_not_implied: the constant-true predicate on Fin 1), and repair_not_implied states only that a constant-true predicate stays true, so it defines no repair. This node proves the general forms of the first two boundaries, a converse and an exact count, keeps the repair statement at the weak persistence reading, and enumerates all (u, r) pairs for small finite sets to see that the claim could fail on them.

Supported: Kernel-checked (types in Type): for arbitrary A, B, E the old-image law r(u a) = inl a implies u injective, hence |A| <= |B| when finite; for arbitrary A, B and E = Unit every injective lift has a law-satisfying recovery r : B -> A + Unit (injective_iff_exists_law; with E empty the converse fails when A is empty and B is not); for injective u the law can be extended by any single value x : A + E at all off-image points (law_freedom_off_image; the independent free value at each off-image point is the content of law_card), so for an off-image point and an old term a0 there are two law-satisfying recoveries, one refusing and one accepting it (off_image_not_implied_general); for any lift u and recovery r, with A nonempty and two distinct observation values, there are observations q, q2 with q2 after u different from q (observation_not_implied_general; the law hypothesis is not used), while q := q2 after u preserves observations on the same lift (observation_preserved_possible), so observation preservation is an extra condition the law neither implies nor excludes; the identity lift satisfies the law while leaving every predicate on the old terms unchanged (repair_not_implied_general, a persistence statement for the identity lift only); for finite A, B and injective u the number of law-satisfying recoveries into A + Unit is (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) (law_card). The three source negative boundaries are fixed Fin instances and are reproduced as such. Native: exhaustive enumeration of all (u, r) pairs for eleven (|A|,|B|,|O|) cases with |A|,|B| <= 4: the number of law pairs, none with a non-injective lift, the number that refuse every off-image point (one per injective lift) and those that do not, observation pairs preserved, and obstruction pairs that persist or clear, all exact integers. Column definitions: persists = number of (law pair, oA, oB) with some a such that oA a and oB (u a); cleared = number with oA nonempty and no such a; these are counting conventions, not a repair notion. obs_preserved, persists and cleared are the law-pair count times a factor independent of r, so they carry no information about the law; the Lean statements carry that claim. The agreement of the producer enumeration with the checker closed forms is the independent evidence, not either alone.

Remaining: Off-image rejection as a property of the S(n) retraction (that is PG-SN-OFF-IMAGE-REFUSAL, which needs an added soundness hypothesis on r); the pinned SnCarrier lift and retraction; any definition of obstruction repair beyond persistence of a Boolean predicate through a lift (the source repair_not_implied instance uses the constant-true predicate and defines no repair); sets with more than four elements in the native census (the Lean count law_card is general for finite types); infinite types for the count; any physical or categorical reading.
